**Finding: Compliant (preferred position met).**

- **Section 12.3 (p0051)** expressly negates any Customer-side MFN: "Vendor acknowledges that Customer has made no exclusivity, non-compete, most-favoured-customer, minimum-volume, or no-hire commitment," and confirms Customer is free to engage any supplier.
- **Section 7.6 (p0031)** is an MFN in *our* favour (Vendor warrants Fees to Customer will be no less favourable than those offered to similarly situated customers). Per the rule's direction guidance, this is welcome and not redlined.
- Sections 4 and 30 contain no best-pricing, right-to-match, or best-terms disclosure mechanic; targeted searches for favourable/favorable, match, benchmark, discount and exclusivity language surfaced nothing else responsive.

No redline proposed.
